# Updates browse design

Grounding: the server loader already validates and supplies every entity; the route renders that model directly. `CategoryWheel` owns rendering/focus only, while feature options own SVG geometry. Its fixed 142px button height currently clips any half-circle path. Existing board entry is 250ms and keyed by category.

Caller shape:
```ts
type UpdateSort = 'newest' | 'oldest';
type UpdateView = { category: UpdateCategory; sort: UpdateSort; visible: number };
const batchSize = 10;
function sortUpdates(rows: readonly EntityUpdate[], sort: UpdateSort): EntityUpdate[];
function selectCategory(category: UpdateCategory): void; // reset visible
function selectSort(sort: UpdateSort): void; // reset visible
```
Initialize `{category:'members', sort:'newest', visible:10}`. Derive sorted rows without mutating page data, then `.slice(0, view.visible)`. Render only that slice during SSR. Show existing `Button` labelled “Show more” only while hidden rows remain; increment visible by 10. Keep sort across category changes; clicking the already selected category need not reset.

Smallest shared extension: add optional `height?: number` to `CategoryWheelOption`; set button height to `option.height ?? 142`. Width remains 142. Existing four quadrants remain byte-for-byte compatible. Updates set height 284, top 0, left 0/142. Left path `M142 8 A134 134 0 0 0 142 276 L142 186 A44 44 0 0 1 142 98 Z`; right-local path `M0 8 A134 134 0 0 1 0 276 L0 186 A44 44 0 0 0 0 98 Z`. Rim paths use outer arcs only. Labels sit at local (73,142)/(69,142). SVG translations and CSS clipping share those local coordinates.

Sort uses full UTC timestamp precision: normalize fractions to nine digits and compare canonical timestamp strings, avoiding Date millisecond truncation. Multiply only date comparison by direction. Ties: `Intl.Collator('en-GB', {sensitivity:'base'})` name comparison, then exact code-point name, then code-point ID. Never reverse the full array. Use two existing compact Buttons (“Newest first”, “Oldest first”) with aria-pressed; no shared Select exists.

Alternative: explicit wheel layout variant controlling geometry/button boxes. Reject: duplicates caller-owned geometry responsibilities and adds a larger API.

Verify shuffled 25+ fixtures, nanosecond/date/case/name/ID ties, both directions, 10→20→remaining, resets, no new fetches, SSR ten links, preserved metadata/profile URLs, keyboard focus, lower-half pointer hit targets, gallery quadrant regression plus semicircle example, narrow layout and reduced motion. Retain board key/animation.
EOF","max_output_tokens":1000}));
